en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Hammad, from Hareyz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the man who happens to be in the Salāt, so he sees the snake or the scorpion. Can he kill these two if they harm him?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Hammad from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who in Salah (prayer) sees a snake or scorpion; can he kill it if it is hurting? He (the Imam) said, ’Yes, he can do so.”’
